scope_label: failure to fulfill an applicable requirement
definition: A nonconformity is a failure to fulfill an applicable requirement.
explanation: A useful finding identifies the object, the requirement, and the evidence of the departure. It should not treat a preference or an unstated expectation as a violated requirement without establishing its status.

A nonconformity may call for correction of the current case, investigation of a cause, or both. It is a defect in the narrower technical sense when the unmet requirement relates to an intended or specified use.
